q1_issues.issue: (Member (sk_feathers $e) feather) types the plural NP 'ground feathers' as a single individual, where a plural set participating in the occurrence takes a group witness (GroupOf ... feather).

(Member (sk_feathers $e) ground) predicates the descriptive participial modifier of the group symbol itself — the group-as-object reading that *Categorical statements* and the plural clause of *Compound concepts* both bar; a descriptive modifier on a plural must distribute to the members.

q2_gaps: a peripheral spatial preposition on an EVENT ('scatters ... around the lantern'): the entity side mandates the surface-preposition head for anything outside in/at/inside/within, but the event side glosses Location only as 'in/at/on ...' and tells you to decide by the question the PP answers ('where'), so whether 'around' takes Location or the preposition-named oblique (Around <event> ...) is unsettled

the role class for 'need' with an inanimate subject: it passes the progressive test for stativity but is not psych/perception, and sits next to the Holder class's 'lack' — neither of the two carve-outs that move a transitive subject off Agent clearly covers it
notes: The whenever-rule machinery is otherwise right — plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, STV 1.0 0.9, definite referents typed at top level, no QuantifierPhrase — and the participial 'ground' correctly keeps its surface form rather than lemmatizing to 'grind'. The two issues are one fault: the plural object was individuated as a singleton instead of a group, which then put its modifier on the group symbol.
